outDir.description: Default output directory for generated files (relative to project root)

clientManagerPath.description: Default import path for the client manager (relative from generated files)

target.description: Default generated runtime target (react emits hooks, core emits only reactor exports)

name.description: Canister name (required). May contain only letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-' — it becomes a directory name. It must also derive a valid TypeScript identifier, so a name beginning with a digit (e.g. '2048_game') is rejected at generation time.

outDir.description: Override output directory for this canister

clientManagerPath.description: Override client manager import path for this canister

mode.description: Reactor class used for generated hooks (defaults to DisplayReactor)

target.description: Generated runtime target for this canister (react emits hooks, core emits only reactor exports)

canisterId.description: Canister ID written into index.generated.ts. Set it for any build not served from a local replica: without it the generated reactor reads the id from the ic_env cookie, and importing it throws in Node, during SSR and on a deployed origin.

factories.description: Also generate index.factories.generated.ts: one object per method, bound to the generated reactor. A query method with no arguments gets createQuery (<method>Query), one with arguments createQueryFactory (<method>Query), and an update or oneway method createMutation (<method>Mutation), with the method name in camelCase. Needs target "react". Switching it off removes the file.
